subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Walsh <sam.walsh@orpheus-analytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & SOC 2 package — post-call recap

Hi Sam — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

1) Goal: Get Orpheus set up on Redwood Dedicated with SOC 2 evidence in place for procurement/infosec sign-off. Target close: 2026-04-15 (we can adjust).

2) Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones. High-priority milestone for your team: Security review & SOC 2 package delivery.

3) Proposed responsibilities:
   - Orpheus: complete vendor security questionnaire; upload requested evidence (access logs, encryption docs, vendor contracts).
   - Redwood: provide SOC 2 report excerpts, security controls mapping, guidance on evidence formats, and a secure upload channel.

4) Dependencies: legal review of our terms, procurement PO, and your internal security resource to gather artifacts.

Requested immediate next steps:
- Sam/Priya: confirm acceptance of the MAP draft and who will own security artifact collection on your side (name + email).
- Orpheus: aim to return the questionnaire within one week (by 2026-03-10).
- Redwood: we will send the SOC 2 checklist and a Drive folder with examples by end of day.

Attachments: 20260303-orpheus-MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP with milestone table)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the SOC 2 checklist and a secure upload link.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
redwood.ai

From: Sam Walsh <sam.walsh@orpheus-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@orpheus-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package — post-call recap

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear summary. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Priya (cc’d) will be the security lead on our side. Priya, can you confirm you’ll own the questionnaire/evidence?
- For the questionnaire timeline: one week is aggressive for us but doable if it’s focused. Can you paste the specific questionnaire deadline into the MAP?
- Also want to confirm which SOC 2 artifacts Redwood will provide vs. what we need to produce. Examples would be helpful.

Sam
VP Product, Orpheus Analytics
sam.walsh@orpheus-analytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Walsh <sam.walsh@orpheus-analytics.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@orpheus-analytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package — MAP milestone details (questionnaire & evidence)

Sam/Priya — thanks. Priya, great to meet you. I’ve updated the MAP (attached) with explicit milestones tied to the security review/SOC 2 package: 

MAP milestone: Security review & SOC 2 package delivery- Target milestone close: 2026-03-17 (internal evidence collection)- Target overall close (deal close contingent on procurement/legal): 2026-04-15- Questionnaire deadline (Orpheus): 2026-03-10- SOC 2 evidence upload (Orpheus): 2026-03-17- Redwood deliverables (by 2026-03-12): redacted SOC 2 report excerpts, control mappings (CSV), and an evidence checklist PDF

Responsibilities:
- Orpheus (Priya): complete questionnaire; collect and upload evidence items listed in the attached checklist.
- Redwood (Marissa/Dev): provide SOC 2 artifacts and technical liaison for any format questions; provide secure upload options (SFTP/Drive link with restricted access).
- Legal/Procurement (Orpheus): issue PO / confirm contract SLAs by 2026-03-24

Dependencies / blockers:
- Procurement PO and legal review (Orpheus) — required to finalize commercial terms.
- If your security team needs an SCP/secure channel for large logs, tell us and we’ll provision an SFTP bucket with expiration.

Attachments included: ORP-SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.pdf (detailed list of requested artifacts), updated MAP (20260303-orpheus-MAP-draft.xlsx)

Notes on evidence: preferred formats are PDFs or CSV exports (no raw DB dumps). We will only request redacted / scope-limited artifacts to avoid PII transfer. Redwood can also provide a SOC 2 report redaction guidance doc.

If this looks good, Priya please reply with: 1) confirmation you own the artifacts, 2) any constraints on the 3/10 questionnaire date, and 3) preferred upload method.

I’ll add these milestones into HubSpot and send an updated MAP link once you confirm.

Thanks — Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@orpheus-analytics.com>, Sam Walsh <sam.walsh@orpheus-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package — technical/evidence notes

Hi Priya/Sam — quick technical notes from Redwood Security side to help plan uploads: 

- We will provide: redacted SOC 2 report excerpts (PDF), a controls mapping CSV, and sample audit logs (redacted). Expect these by 2026-03-12.
- For evidence uploads: we recommend a shared Drive folder for small docs and SFTP for log sets >250MB. We can provision a time-limited SFTP account if needed.
- Please avoid sending raw production DB exports or any files with customer PII. If an artifact contains identifiers, please redact or provide a process walkthrough.
- Contact for secure ingestion: security-uploads@redwood.ai (we’ll triage and confirm receipt).

If Orpheus would like, we can run a short intake call with your security team to walk through the checklist. I’m happy to join.

Thanks — Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

- Questionnaire (due 2026-03-10): owner Priya Desai (Orpheus)
- Evidence upload (due 2026-03-17): owner Priya Desai (Orpheus)
- Redwood deliverables (due 2026-03-12): owner Dev Patel
- Legal/PO (target 2026-03-24): owner Sam Walsh

Next steps from Redwood (this week):
- I’ll push updated MAP into HubSpot and send the Drive + SFTP provisioning request to Priya.
- Dev will share redacted SOC 2 artifacts by 3/12 and stand up intake if needed.

Priya/Sam — can you reply to confirm these owners & dates or propose adjustments? Once you confirm I’ll mark the MAP milestone live and schedule a 30-min intake call with Dev.

Appreciate it — Marissa
